verdict.rationale: 1Password documents several programmatic surfaces of its own: the op CLI, SDKs for programmatic item management, the Connect REST API for items and vaults, and the Events API for activity data. Together these cover core item and vault operations, but nothing in the evidence claims or shows parity with the UI. Many UI features (Watchtower, passkey creation, import/export, browser autofill) appear only as app features, and the OpenAPI specs cover only the Events and Connect surfaces. missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, API coverage of Watchtower/passkeys/import-export/sharing/account admin, independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
